stem: Which statement best describes the global burden of diarrhoeal disease?

options.text: It is greatest in children under 5 years and in South-East Asia
It is greatest in healthy adults in metropolitan Australia
It is equally distributed across all ages and regions
It is greatest only in neonates in Europe
It is mainly in older adolescents in North America

explanation: The correct answer is children under 5 years and South-East Asia. This best matches the global epidemiology described for diarrhoeal disease, which places the greatest burden in young children and in that region.

citations.title: Global perspectives of paediatric infectious diseases

rationale: This tests recognition of the main age group and geographic region carrying the highest global burden of diarrhoeal disease.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because the greatest global burden of diarrhoeal disease is described in children under 5 years and in South-East Asia.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because healthy adults in metropolitan Australia are not described as the group with the greatest global burden.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because the burden is not presented as equal across all ages and regions.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because the greatest burden is not limited to neonates or to Europe.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because older adolescents in North America are not identified as the main burden group.
